raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Stacked on https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46066: this PR's base is that PR's branch until it lands, so the diff shown here is only this change. It builds on `rust_server_serves_kv_bootstrap`, which that PR adds.

## Motivation

In Python mode the `TokenizerManager` calls `start_disagg_service`, which on a prefill node brings up the transfer backend's KV bootstrap server. The Rust server starts no `TokenizerManager`. Its own api listener serves the HTTP registry, which covers every backend whose `BOOTSTRAP_SERVER` is a `CommonKVBootstrapServer`, but a backend with a bootstrap server of its own was left with nothing listening. The `PrefillBootstrapQueue`'s `KVManager` registers to the bootstrap server synchronously during scheduler init, and a failed registration only retries briefly before logging, after which no PD request can be routed to that prefill.

## Modifications

- `python/sglang/srt/managers/disagg_service.py`: add `start_disagg_service_for_rust_server()`. On a prefill node whose backend's bootstrap server is not a `CommonKVBootstrapServer` it starts that server via `start_disagg_service`; otherwise it returns `None`. The note on `maybe_create_ascend_config_store` now describes both shapes the bootstrap server can take in Rust mode.
- `python/sglang/srt/entrypoints/engine.py`: in Rust-server mode, call it from the main process at the point where the `TokenizerManager` would have started the server in Python mode: after the schedulers launch and before waiting for them to become ready, so the prefill ranks find it when they register. The handle is kept on `SchedulerInitResult.kv_bootstrap_server`.
- `python/sglang/srt/managers/scheduler.py`: the comment on the rust-server prefill path now covers both the embedded registry and a backend-owned bootstrap server. The code there is unchanged: only the ascend config store is still created in the scheduler.
- `test/registered/unit/entrypoints/test_rust_server_dp_ports.py`: the two bootstrap-server test doubles now assert which of them may be constructed, and a new parametrized test covers the three cases: an HTTP-registry backend starts nothing, a backend with its own bootstrap server is started on the configured host and port on prefill, and decode starts nothing.

Built-in backends (nixl, mooncake, mori, ascend) are unchanged: the Rust server keeps serving their registry on the api port.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: no model forward or kernel code changes.

- `test/registered/unit/entrypoints/test_rust_server_dp_ports.py`: 40 tests pass on this branch (37 existing, 3 new parametrized cases of `test_rust_mode_starts_only_a_bootstrap_server_rust_cannot_serve`).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable: one class lookup at engine startup on Rust-server prefill.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations): no user-facing flag changes.
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed): not applicable.

 )
 from sglang.srt.managers.detokenizer_manager import run_detokenizer_process
+from sglang.srt.managers.disagg_service import start_disagg_service_for_rust_server
 from sglang.srt.managers.io_struct import (
     BeginWeightUpdateReqInput,
     CloseSessionReqInput,
@@ -180,6 +181,8 @@ class SchedulerInitResult:
     wait_for_ready: Callable[[], None] = lambda: None
     block_until_scheduler_exits: Callable[[], None] = lambda: None
     engine_info_bootstrap_server: Optional[Any] = None
+    # Rust-server mode only: a KV bootstrap server the Rust server cannot serve.
+    kv_bootstrap_server: Optional[Any] = None
     grpc_server: Optional[Any] = None
 
     def stop_grpc_server(self) -> None:
@@ -1293,6 +1296,11 @@ def sigterm_handler(signum, frame):
         # not start the Python detokenizer subprocess(es) or tokenizer manager.
         # Do not use RayEngine with the Rust server, as it is not supported.
         if envs.SGLANG_RUST_SERVER.get():
+            # In place of the tokenizer manager, which starts the KV bootstrap
+            # server in Python mode.
+            scheduler_init_result.kv_bootstrap_server = (
+                start_disagg_service_for_rust_server()
+            )
             scheduler_init_result.wait_for_ready()
             # Set up subprocess liveness watchdog to detect crashes
             processes = list(scheduler_procs or [])

@@ -66,13 +66,23 @@ def rust_server_serves_kv_bootstrap(transfer_backend: str) -> bool:
     )
 
 
+def start_disagg_service_for_rust_server():
+    """Rust-server mode has no TokenizerManager to call ``start_disagg_service``.
+    Its prefill server serves the HTTP registry itself, so start only a
+    bootstrap server it cannot stand in for, before the prefill ranks register."""
+    if get_disagg().disaggregation_mode != "prefill" or (
+        rust_server_serves_kv_bootstrap(get_disagg().disaggregation_transfer_backend)
+    ):
+        return None
+    return start_disagg_service()
+
+
 def maybe_create_ascend_config_store(transfer_backend: TransferBackend) -> None:
     """Also called directly by the rust-server scheduler: there the KV
-    bootstrap registry is served by the embedded rust server's api listener
-    (one rust implementation covers every transfer backend — their
-    bootstrap-server subclasses are all plain ``CommonKVBootstrapServer``,
-    which the rust registry ports verbatim), leaving this store as the only
-    ``start_disagg_service`` duty left to perform."""
+    bootstrap server is either the embedded rust server's registry (see
+    ``rust_server_serves_kv_bootstrap``) or the backend's own server, which
+    ``start_disagg_service_for_rust_server`` starts in the main process, leaving
+    this store as the only ``start_disagg_service`` duty for the scheduler."""
     if not (
         get_parallel().node_rank == 0 and transfer_backend == TransferBackend.ASCEND
     ):

@@ -1497,12 +1497,15 @@ def init_disaggregation(self):
             get_disagg().disaggregation_transfer_backend
         )
 
-        # In rust-server mode the KV bootstrap registry is already serving on
-        # the rust api listener (maybe_init_rust_server runs before this
-        # method — the PrefillBootstrapQueue's KVManager below registers to it
-        # synchronously, and a failed registration only retries ~60s then logs,
-        # leaving every PD request unroutable). Only the ascend config store,
-        # which start_disagg_service would otherwise create, is left to do.
+        # In rust-server mode the KV bootstrap server is already up before the
+        # PrefillBootstrapQueue's KVManager below registers to it (synchronously;
+        # a failed registration only retries ~60s then logs, leaving every PD
+        # request unroutable): either the rust api listener serves the HTTP
+        # registry (maybe_init_rust_server runs before this method), or, for a
+        # transfer backend with its own bootstrap server, the main process has
+        # started that server (start_disagg_service_for_rust_server). Only the
+        # ascend config store, which start_disagg_service would otherwise
+        # create, is left to do here.
         if (
             self.disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.PREFILL
             and self._hosts_rust_server()

@@ -271,11 +271,13 @@ def test_scale_joiner_hosts_listener():
 
 
 class _HttpRegistry(CommonKVBootstrapServer):
-    pass
+    def __init__(self, host, port):
+        raise AssertionError("the Rust server serves this registry")
 
 
 class _OwnBootstrapServer(BaseKVBootstrapServer):
-    pass
+    def __init__(self, host, port):
+        self.address = (host, port)
 
 
 @pytest.mark.parametrize(
@@ -314,5 +316,34 @@ def test_rust_prefill_bootstrap_port_alias(server_class, bootstrap_port, expecte
     assert resolving_view(args).disaggregation_bootstrap_port == expected
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "mode,server_class,starts",
+    [
+        ("prefill", _HttpRegistry, False),
+        ("prefill", _OwnBootstrapServer, True),
+        ("decode", _OwnBootstrapServer, False),
+    ],
+    ids=["http-registry", "backend-bootstrap-server", "decode"],
+)
+def test_rust_mode_starts_only_a_bootstrap_server_rust_cannot_serve(
+    mode, server_class, starts
+):
+    with (
+        get_context().override_server_args(
+            host="127.0.0.1",
+            disaggregation_mode=mode,
+            disaggregation_transfer_backend="nixl",
+            disaggregation_bootstrap_port=33000,
+        ),
+        patch.object(disagg_service, "get_kv_class", return_value=server_class),
+    ):
+        server = disagg_service.start_disagg_service_for_rust_server()
+
+    if starts:
+        assert server.address == ("127.0.0.1", 33000)
+    else:
+        assert server is None
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     raise SystemExit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v"]))
